اعتقدتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَدَتَا (iʕtaqadatā) /iʕ.ta.qa.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اُعْتُقِدَتَا (uʕtuqidatā) /uʕ.tu.qi.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
